''See also: [[Witnesses (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Witnesses are a specialized guild responsible for maintaining and distributing official records of significant historical events, such as the appointment of an [[Imperial]] heir. They function with a high degree of neutrality, which is formally verified by groups consisting of pairs of individuals: [[Chroniclers]], who carry belts of wax candles, and [[Silent Ones]], who keep their mouths covered and are heavily armed. The guild's testimony holds significant weight in public affairs, such as confirming the true nature of political conflicts or accusations involving high-ranking officials.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A pair of members from the Witnesses, an [[Imperial]] [[Guild]], approached [[Calder]] with a request to transport them to an island for the retrieval of a relic. During their interactions with [[Calder]] and Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel, the group maintained a tight grip on their weapons, though [[Calder]] noted he had dealt with these individuals in the past. Despite appearing tired, the group demonstrated their unique ability to relive recorded memories through the burning of specific candles. This guild has a history of working alongside the [[Blackwatch]], and their status is further evidenced by [[Guards]] who serve them.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Witnesses are a group that [[Calder]] and Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel are interacting with.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Calder]] has past experience with Witnesses.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}</li>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Witnesses serve as a tool for investigating news reports, possessing the ability to either verify or deny any published story. Within the Palace, a pair of these entities is stationed at the dungeon checkpoint. Their influence extends to public discourse, as seen when they published an article exonerating the [[Imperialist Guilds]] for attacks carried out in pursuit of justice. Furthermore, the Witnesses are responsible for issuing the official public declaration regarding the dissolution of the [[Champions]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Witnesses can be used to investigate news reports.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Witnesses can verify or deny any story put out.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Palace dungeon]] checkpoint includes a pair of Witnesses.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Witnesses published an article exonerating the [[Imperialist Guilds]] for attacks conducted in pursuit of justice.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Witnesses are responsible for issuing the public declaration of the [[Champions]]' dissolution.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
